content.description:
Our vision is to support a decentralized, permissionless and open economy, empowered by integrated blockchain ecosystem

To establish a high performance, Ethereum compatible, dApp developing platform on Plutus of Cardano Fourier Protocol is Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) built on Cardano. It provides high efficiency and low cost solution for dApp developers to implement Ethereum compatible smart contracts on Cardano. It also offers sleek dApp user experience on Cardano and help user to move token cross chain smoothly and economically.

Fourier Protocol creates the first industry smart contract programming environment with the ability to process account based transactions on eUTXO ledger. As a result, any Ethereum based smart contract can run on Cardano to enjoy high scalable, secure, sustainable features of the Cardano with low transaction cost.
